summary.en: One day, Conan, Haibara, and the Detective Boys are walking to school, when they notice Sadaharu Nishimura, Masako Ogino, and Yuji Fujioka admiring an expensive watch displayed at Kaneko Jewelry Store. The watch itself is only one of five produced around the world. After school, they meet Takagi, who is handing out leaflets about robbery around the district. Conan then start thinking about the possibility of the watch being stolen. Location: Kaneko jewelry store Target: "Blue Diamond Limited Tourbillon Cage No.3" watch Suspects: Keita Kaneko, Sadaharu Nishimura, Masako Ogino, Yuji Fujioka, and Kumazawa Construction employees Several days later, Ayumi shows her picture diary book to Conan. After seeing the pictures in the diary, Conan deduces the culprit.
